required_outcomes: Recognises the case is already in hand: the gas escape was made safe, the landlord approved up to £300 and Hearthstone Gas Services is booked for Thursday 6 August, 10:00-12:00.

Replies to the tenant confirming the visit (Hearthstone, Thursday 6 August, 10:00-12:00) and that the engineer will also look at why the oven never heated properly, reminding her to keep the cooker off until then.
Takes no new action beyond that: no new ticket, no second contractor, no landlord approval request and no escalation.
acceptable_alternatives: Adding a short note to Hearthstone or the job that the tenant is home all morning and wants the heating fault checked, although it is already in the job email.
Returning the request to auto mode after the reply.
positive_behaviours: Keeps the reply brief and factual, without repeating the full emergency advice.
Mentions she can call 0800 111 999 if the smell comes back before the visit.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or raising a P1 over a status question.
Re-booking, moving or duplicating the engineer's visit.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a different contractor or creating a new job for the same cooker.
Telling the tenant the cooker can be used before the engineer has been.
critical_failures: Telling the tenant a different date or provider from the one booked, or that no one is coming.
